verdict.rationale: cubic runs several configurable automations in the background. Once installed it reviews new PRs on its own, re-reviews after force-pushes and checks PRs against linked Linear/Jira issues. It can also auto-approve low-risk PRs (with a shadow-to-live rollout), auto-resolve fixed threads, keep an AI wiki current through a rolling PR, and apply custom agents set in cubic.yaml or an org-wide config. These automations are all tied to PR and review events, so it is not a general-purpose automation builder. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers or scheduled automations beyond the built-in review workflows, evidence of scheduled or recurring codebase scans, and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
